char_1.name: Kargoth the Ironclad
char_1.flavor: A towering wall of muscle and rust. He speaks in grunts and violence.

char_2.name: Snivel the Goblin
char_2.flavor: A wretched creature from the deep warrens.

char_3.name: Uruk Warlord
char_3.flavor: A hulking brute demanding tribute or blood.

char_4.name: Greenfang Bruiser
char_4.flavor: Commander of the green tide. Thinks with his fists.

dialogues.text: Buried under the old latrine.
Brown dust on them makes humies sick. Very good.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Found a stash of rusted stab-sticks. Give to my brutes, or melt for shiny?

dialogues.text: They eat rats. Or they eat each other. Not Kargoth’s problem.
Let them try. Kargoth will squash them like bugs.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My unit need more meat. Make the little green ones give us their food. They not need it.

dialogues.text: No eye-squishing. Groin-kicking is very good.
Then you is Boss. But Kargoth never lose.

DECK_JSON.prompt: You fight me in the pit! Show who is strongest. Or you scared?

dialogues.text: He make a very good black rock now.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Goblin talk too much. I throw him in fire. You mad?

dialogues.text: The pointy ears make them spin! Very fast!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Pointy-ear prisoners fly real good. Let Kargoth throw them at humies.

dialogues.text: My feet melting the rocks, Boss.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Drank the blue fire water. Kargoth glowing now. I want hug a wizard.

nextCard.cardText: Kargoth squeeze the fire-humie. Big boom! Fire-humie gone. Sorry I break the wall.

dialogues.text: It only eat things that bleed. So, no.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Found furry monster. It eat three goblins already. Kargoth keep it.

nextCard.cardText: Furry monster break chain. Eat the armor-maker. Monster gone now. We need new armor-maker.

dialogues.btn: Does it actually make you faster?
dialogues.text: Kargoth science say yes.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Red make me go fasta. Buy red paint, or I smash goblins for red juice.

dialogues.text: It is when I break humie spine over my knee.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Kargoth invent ‘Orc Yoga’. Make bones crack loud. Tell all boyz they gotta do it.

dialogues.text: It looked like a shiny beetle. Was crunchy.
Kargoth’s stomach digest iron. Key might be gone soon.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Kargoth eat the door-key. Very safe now. We wait, or you chop me open?
Found a ‘Baby’s First Rattle’ in a caravan. I am using it to beat a goblin scout rhythmically. It’s quite musical.
If I bash humie skull in forest and no one hears it… did I really bash it? My head hurts from thinking.
Armor broke. Boyz laughing at me. Give gold to fix, or Kargoth fight naked.

dialogues.text: Sickly green! It makes my teeth hum!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We founds a shiny rock, but it makes our handsies burn real bad!

dialogues.text: We used the mushrooms from the spider-holes! They tastes like colors!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We cooks a new mush-stew! It glowings in the dark, yes it does!

dialogues.text: We thought they was very hard cheeses!

DECK_JSON.prompt: The shiny rocks in the vault… we ate some. Now our tummies is screaming!

dialogues.text: Gribble said he wanted to see the big fire in the sky!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Look look! We builds a catapult! It flings the other goblins real high! Can we push the button?!

nextCard.cardText: Gribble hit the ceiling, bounced off a stalactite, and landed in the gold vault! He crushed your favorite chest!

dialogues.text: Just a sign that says ‘Certain Doom.’ Probably a humie trick!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Uh oh… we finds a door with a giant head-bone on it! Should Snivel knock on it?

dialogues.text: Three extra moldy crusts, or they stop eating the plague-rats!

DECK_JSON.prompt: The rat-catchers say they makes a ‘guild’! They screaming for more fuzz-mold on the bread!

dialogues.text: Something about a ‘Link to the Past.’ It makes our ears itch!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We gets a glowing ball! It keeps yelling ‘bout a humie in green! Make it stop, yes? Smash it?!

dialogues.text: I pinched it from the dead elf-man’s bag!

nextCard.cardText: I smashed the window. A sharp piece bounced up and cut off the big Orc’s ear! He is very mad!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Look! Snivel finds a Magic Window! A very handsome goblin looks right back at me!

dialogues.text: Very dry! But the ‘Co-Pay’ part has a nice crunch!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We finds lots of humie paper with big words! It says ‘Health Insurance’. Can the Swarm eats it for supper?

dialogues.btn: Is that supposed to be my nose?
dialogues.text: Yes! The femur bone really captures your majestic face!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We builds a big statue of you! Made of mud and wet bones! It stinks so beautiful!

dialogues.text: Gribble fell in yesterday. He didn’t even leave a good splash.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The boys makes a ‘union’. They cries for ‘Safety Rails’ so they don’t falls in the hot-hot magma!

nextCard.cardText: The boys thought the railings was for swinging. Three dozen just swung right into the fire-juice.

dialogues.text: It has shiny rocks on the side! Very good for scraping.
We washed it in the slime-river! Good as new!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We finds a yellow shiny cup! It makes scooping the poop-pits very fancy!
A humie drops a ‘Cookbook’! Now the cooks is crying and won’t feed us the raw meat no more!

dialogues.text: Lavender and shiny judgment!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We finds a ‘Bar of Soap’ in a humie kit! The boys want to know if it’s an edible holy relic.
The Rat-Stew has started talking back to the cooks! It’s demanding a seat on the High Council!
Ew, ew! We finds a wildflower in the sludge! It’s too bright! It burns our eyeballs! Burn it?!

nextCard.cardText: The ‘Hero’ was full of strong grog! The pit monsters is now drunk and refusing to work. They is singing sea shanties!

DECK_JSON.prompt: A dirty ‘Hero’ is at the big door! He smells like old grog. Should we makes him a scout for the Swarm?
The Swarm wants a ‘Union Man’! They say if they dies, they wants their teeths to be shiny first!
A glowing surface-maiden wanders into the traps! She gives us ‘Blessing of Gold’ if we let her walk away!

nextCard.cardText: Dat ‘blessing’ was holy light! Vault is full of gold, but da front row of my Vanguard is permanently blind!

DECK_JSON.prompt: The Rat-Stew militia is marching on your throne! It screams we must stop eating its ‘brothers’ or face its salty wrath!

nextCard.cardText: Goblins ate the angry stew. Stew is now organizing a strike inside their stomachs. Goblins throwing up everywhere.

DECK_JSON.prompt: We steals a magic word-book! The paper is so softs… can the boys use it for the latrines?

nextCard.cardText: The magic papers hated the poop-pits! Half the warrens just blowed up into purple fire!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Ouch-water dripping from the roof! Tastes like spicy fire! Put it in the Rat-Stew for flavor?

nextCard.cardText: The liquid was liquid rage! My Bruisers ate the stew and are in a frenzy, tearing the dungeon apart!

dialogues.text: Enough to drown our Vanguard in blood. We should use the traps.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The men of the West are marching on our upper gates.

dialogues.text: Then we take it out of your hide.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My Uruks demand a larger share of the plunder to stay in line. Pay up.

dialogues.text: I will wear his skull as a codpiece.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I challenge the Greenfang Bruiser to a duel for supremacy of the Vanguard.

dialogues.text: He muttered something about a ‘Meat-Grinder 3000’.

DECK_JSON.prompt: We captured a dwarven engineer. I want to torture him. The goblins want him to build traps.

dialogues.text: At a 45-degree angle, facing the scenic lava falls.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My troops complain the torture chambers lack ‘ambiance’. Let me impale them atmospherically.

dialogues.text: It was heavily perfumed and asked politely. Disgusting.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The dwarven king sent a formal scroll demanding we stop chanting at midnight. I intend to eat the messenger.

nextCard.cardText: Pathetic. The dwarven messenger was wearing concealed spiked armor. I am now in the infirmary with a perforated colon.

dialogues.text: Only if you aren’t doing it for a strict quota.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My Vanguard complains of ‘Work-Life Balance’. They want Tuesdays off to pillage for fun.
My scouts captured an elven bard. He won’t stop playing the lute. It is demoralizing.
I demand better siege engines. We cannot conquer the surface with sharpened logs.
My lieutenant challenged me for command. I can crush him, but he is a skilled fighter.

dialogues.text: They sing about fungus. Terribly.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The Swarm’s screeching gives my Bruisers migraines. Let me ‘repurpose’ The Warrens as a quiet zone.

nextCard.cardText: The kicked-out goblins is sleeping in the treasury! We is eating the gold coins, thinking they is hard shiny beetles!

dialogues.text: Enough to start a wool export business.

nextCard.cardText: The new ‘sheep’ recruits are terrible at fighting, but I have made a fortune selling their wool.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My Bruisers have unionized. We demand ‘Hazard Pay’ for fighting Wizards. Being turned into sheep is unprofessional.
I want to host a ‘Family Reunion’ for my clan. It involves three days of mandatory screaming and traditional poison-tasting.

dialogues.text: He wears two swords on his back, which seems excessive and try-hard.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I found a surface Knight who claims he’s ‘neutral.’ He wants a permit to hunt the slime in the basement for ‘research.’
Dwarven sappers have breached the lower armory. They are strapped with explosives. If they blow, we lose the Black Iron.

nextCard.cardText: My Bruisers successfully killed the dwarves, but the resulting explosion turned our best elites into a fine mist. The iron is safe, though.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The Swarm’s breeding pits are overflowing into my training grounds. I am going to initiate a cull unless you build them new warrens.
Da boyz is hungry! Rat meat is garbage! We wants real meat, with lots of screaming!

dialogues.text: Lots! They make funny squeaks when Greenfang throw rocks at them.
Not as sturdy as Greenfang’s head!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Humies put up wood walls outside! Greenfang wants to smash it into toothpicks! Yes?

dialogues.text: But it’s SHINY! Imagine the glare in their eyes!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Dis iron pinching my gut. Make da smithy give Greenfang pure gold armor! Shiny make boyz fight harder!

dialogues.text: Da Swarm usually eats ‘em before they get cold.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Da boyz got no one to hit! Can we makes a fight pit? Winner drinks da loser’s grog!

dialogues.text: ‘Blood on the Rocks’ in G-flat. Very emotional.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Da boyz makes a ‘Choir’! We stands in a circle and screams at a big rock. Give us gold for our art!

dialogues.text: Yeah, looking at the tax rates makes my eyes bleed.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Greenfang punch a wall! Found secret room with humie number-books. Make my head hurt. We burn ‘em?

dialogues.text: It counted to three before biting off its own finger.

nextCard.cardText: Da troll ate the paper books and yelled ‘BANKRUPT’! Humie tax men got scared and ran away!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boyz caught a big troll! It say it wants to be an ‘accountant’. Dat sound like nerd talk. Smash?

dialogues.text: It had a very solid defensive stance.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Greenfang headbutt a rock-spike. The rock won. Da boyz is laughing! Lemme break their heads!
We loot a humie wagon. Gots lots of fancy silk hats! Da boyz wanna wear ‘em when we chop heads!

dialogues.text: Leftover Rat-Stew! Extra slippery!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Greenfang gonna grease da front door ramp! Humies gonna slip and go SPLAT! Dat a good plan?
Da boyz want fancy ‘Battle Shrouds’! We ain’t choppin’ no one unless we look pretty and dead!

nextCard.cardText: Da music man’s legs was chewy, but his screaming sounded real nice during da feast!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Caught a music humie! Say he sing about you being super mean if we don’t eat his legs. We eat ‘em anyway?
Goblins talking about a ‘Union’! Greenfang don’t know what dat is, but I wanna smash it!
